stackDivergence.rationale: Immutable host UTF16 strings and explicit scalar iteration represent the original native Unicode value/escape loop; native pointer and buffer allocation ABI is not certified.

preservedResponsibilities: Consumed native INetURLObject::decode ToIUri and Unambiguous UTF8 branches share original escaped scalar validation, invalid octet preservation and uppercase escapes. Unambiguous uses the exact PART_UNAMBIGUOUS ASCII bit projection from aMustEncodeMap; raw spelling and nonrecursive percent handling remain distinct. Actual HTML named-target filtering consumes it, with shared decoder and real Markdown parser tests. General URL/smart-relative parsing, non-UTF8 charsets and other decode modes remain unported; whole-module and compiled native equivalence are unverified.
omittedResponsibilities: General URL/smart-relative parsing, non-UTF8 decoding and other modes are unported. Actual consumed decoder source tests are not a full URL class or compiled desktop certificate.
